```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
ggplot(mpg, aes(x = displ, y = hwy, color = class)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Bigger engines, lower highway mileage",
    x = "Engine size (liters)",
    y = "Highway miles per gallon",
    color = "Vehicle class"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
